Amazon AU used-condition searches; books, comics, manuals and identifiable audiobooks excluded. Blank notebooks, calendars, planners, films, music and games retained.
None. Prices below A$20 are included.
First comparison price displayed on the search listing. Amazon often labels this 'used & new offers'; this is not a verified used-only seller offer.
Main current product price displayed on the same search listing. Crossed-out RRP, unit prices, coupons, delivery and conditional discounts are excluded.
New price / used price - 1. For example, 0.50 means the new price is 50% higher than the displayed comparison price. This is not the usual percentage discount from new.
Amazon search department of the retained observation. Items can appear in multiple departments; this is not a verified product-level taxonomy.
Unique ASINs with both numeric prices > 0. Latest qualifying observation retained, sorted by used price ascending. Not a claim to be Amazon's globally cheapest 15,000 items.
Source observations collected 12–13 October 2026; row timestamps are UTC. Prices and availability can change.
